sources.title: BLOOD THE LAST VAMPIRE上巻完全攻略 (XNEO)
sources.notes: Complete choice-by-choice walkthrough for Joukan (Volume 1): full B.S.S. (Blood Search System) trigger list with exact preceding dialogue lines, and the full choice sequence for all 19 Joukan endings. Used as a primary source for Joukan structure and exact choice/BSS text.

sources.title: BLOOD THE LAST VAMPIRE下巻完全攻略 (XNEO)
sources.notes: Complete choice-by-choice walkthrough for Gekan (Volume 2): full B.S.S. trigger list and the full choice sequence for all 27 Gekan endings, labelled by route (闇の王編/究明編/灯子編/瑠璃亜編) where applicable, plus BLOOD level thresholds gating specific choices. Used as a primary source for Gekan structure and exact choice/BSS text.

sources.title: BLOOD THE LAST VAMPIRE - ドラやる？ (mmitsuru), via Wayback Machine
sources.notes: Second independent complete Japanese walkthrough, hosted on a now-dead personal site and recovered via web.archive.org (live snapshots used: index.htm 2016-05-06, geflag.htm 2005-03-09, geoooka.htm 2005-03-09, per-ending pages joend01-19.htm and geend01-27.htm mostly 2009-05-20/2009-05-23). Structured as one page per ending plus dedicated pages for the B.S.S. lists, the Joukan-to-Gekan flag carry-over rules (geflag.htm), and the Gekan 'Ooka Report' shortcut flowchart (geoooka.htm). This site is what confirmed the true ending is Gekan End27 '真・瑠璃亜編', the exact 3 carry-over flags and their names, and the Ooka Report shortcut mechanic. Cross-validated against xneo.jp: both agree on 19 Joukan / 27 Gekan endings and on the 4 named route labels, though the two sites number the Gekan endings in a different order (see disagreements).

sources.title: Blood: The Last Vampire - Guide and Walkthrough (by Gene, GameFAQs, PSP)
sources.notes: Supplementary English guide referenced only; GameFAQs blocked automated fetches (HTTP 403) so its content could not be directly verified in this research pass. Listed here for completeness/attribution; not used as a source of fact given it could not be read. Should be treated as secondary to the two Japanese sources per policy regardless.
